sourceCorrections.rationale: The exact official IGN/INSEE label “Agglomération Ouest-Sud-Ouest” is explicitly retained for this exact source ID after full Guide Alpha review. It is a locally qualified human sector or land-use label, and the official datasets available to the pipeline provide no safer polygon crosswalk for a 1:1 rename.
